parrafo_1.es: Mikes Pro Detailing es un taller de detailing en Seminole Heights, Tampa, dirigido por Mike. Atienden autos, camionetas y botes por igual, y tambien ofrecen tintado de ventanas.
parrafo_1.en: Mikes Pro Detailing is a detailing shop in Seminole Heights, Tampa, run by Mike. They handle cars, trucks and boats alike, and also offer window tint.

parrafo_2.es: Reseña tras reseña dicen lo mismo: gente buena, trabajo de calidad y precio honesto. Pritam Kanchan confio en Mike para quitar manchas de pintura y dejar su auto como nuevo, por dentro y por fuera.

items.quote: Good people did a quality job at an honest price. They do all the work themselves but I didn't mind waiting at the business for them to finish up...

I had given my car for paint spots removal and internal and external detailing. The owner Mike was very confident that he will remove all spots and car will look new inside out. He is a sweet talker...
We really appreciate Mike's Pro detailing for cleaning of our car! Thank you for the hospitality and great job! It smells and looks like new now!
